name: duckie-pomdp-f10-l1-lane-v1
purpose: F10-L1 small_loop counter-clockwise lane-state SAC training with online W&B telemetry; YOLO and EKF are intentionally outside this curriculum stage

install_phases.reason: Warm-reuse the validated F10 CUDA environment; F10-L1 adds no dependency
install_phases.command: python -c "import gym, numpy, torch, ultralytics, wandb; print(numpy.__version__, torch.__version__, ultralytics.__version__, wandb.__version__)"

validation.import_smoke: python -c "import gym, numpy, torch, ultralytics, wandb; print(numpy.__version__, torch.__version__, ultralytics.__version__, wandb.__version__)"
validation.cuda_witness: python -c "import torch; torch.manual_seed(13000); x=torch.randn(8,8,device='cuda'); print('F10_L1_WITNESS', tuple((x@x).shape), float((x@x).sum()), torch.cuda.get_device_name())"
validation.focused_tests: python -m pytest tests/test_f10_l1_protocol.py tests/test_f10_l1_observation.py tests/test_f10_l1_reward.py tests/test_f10_l1_environment.py tests/test_f10_l1_evaluation.py -q --disable-warnings
